name_note: The genus is new: most of its literature appears under the older name Coprococcus comes, which was reclassified as Allocoprococcus comes in 2026.

sentences.text: Allocoprococcus was proposed after genomic analysis showed that Coprococcus comes is distinct from Coprococcus sensu stricto; the species was renamed Allocoprococcus comes.
The genus also contains Allocoprococcus similis, an obligately anaerobic, Gram-stain-positive coccobacillus isolated from faecal samples of healthy Japanese volunteers.
Allocoprococcus comes is a member of the Lachnospiraceae that takes up acetate, propionate and butyrate from its surroundings and incorporates them into valerate and caproate.
It is a gut-native commensal and has been engineered to secrete the cytokine interleukin-22 in the mouse intestinal tract.
